title: hieracium vulgatum subsp. percissum
intro: Hieracium vulgatum subsp. percissum, commonly known as a type of hawkweed, is a plant species known for its medicinal properties. This plant is valued for its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it beneficial for treating various health conditions. The health benefits of Hieracium vulgatum subsp. percissum include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
